$comment: Every Cloudflare Worker secret Switchboard provisions: its name and which Worker(s) hold it. This file is the contract — src/core/secretsManifest.test.ts keeps it equal to each worker.ts `Env` interface and to the bot container's forwarding list. WHERE the values live is the deployment profile's `secretsSource` (a directory of <NAME> files, `~/.secrets/switchboard` by default, or a 1Password item `op://Vault/Item` with one field per name); `deploy secrets <worker>` (`npm run secrets` in each deploy/cloudflare*/) puts them, refusing before any upload when a required value is absent. A shared bearer must carry ONE value on every Worker listed for it. Rotation: new value at the source, `deploy secrets` on EVERY listed Worker, then `deploy restart` for the bot (its running container keeps the env it started with). Public config (URLs, ids of no consequence) is a wrangler.jsonc var, not a secret.

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.note: Slack app bot token (xoxb-). Third-party; rotate in the Slack app config.

secrets.name: SLACK_APP_TOKEN
secrets.note: Slack app-level token (xapp-) for Socket Mode. Third-party.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.note: Anthropic Console key the bot runs on. Third-party.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY
secrets.note: Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin…) for the LLM-spend layer of GET /costs. Absent, /costs shows the Cloudflare side only.

secrets.name: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
secrets.note: Brave Search API key for the research agent's web search. Third-party.

secrets.name: CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN
secrets.note: Cloudflare API token for the installation's account, Account Analytics:Read — prices GET /costs from billing data.

secrets.name: SWITCHBOARD_INGRESS_TOKENS
secrets.note: JSON bearer→identity map for POST /ingress and POST /mcp. Self-minted (openssl rand -hex 32 per entry).

secrets.name: SANDBOX_TOKEN
secrets.note: Shared bearer: bot → thread-sandbox Worker. Self-minted.

secrets.name: RESIDENT_OPERATOR_TOKEN
secrets.note: Shared bearer: bot runtime → resident Worker attach/exec/read/write/status. Self-minted. Rotating it breaks in-flight resident runs — check /runs is empty first.

secrets.name: RESIDENT_ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.note: Shared bearer: `repo onboard/offboard/reconfigure/rebuild` → resident admin routes; also the resident deploy preflight. Self-minted.

secrets.name: RESIDENT_READ_TOKEN
secrets.note: Read-only /residents + debug routes; what the resident deploy preflight needs (CI holds this one). Self-minted.

secrets.name: MCP_CREDENTIAL_KEY
secrets.note: AES-256-GCM key (32 bytes, base64: `openssl rand -base64 32`) the bot seals MCP server credentials with before they go to the state Worker's McpDO (features/mcp-tools.md). Bot-only by design: the Worker stores ciphertext. Rotation re-seals every credential — not built yet; rotate = users re-run `mcp connect`.

secrets.name: MEMORY_TOKEN
secrets.note: Shared bearer for the state Worker (memory, friction ledger, run history, schedule firings). ONE value on all three Workers — a resident with a different mint 401s on every watchdog firing record. Self-minted.

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
secrets.note: The installation's GitHub App id. Not sensitive, but lives alongside the key so both Workers mint installation tokens the same way.

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID
secrets.note: The App's installation id on the organization the bot works in. Not sensitive.

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.note: The App's PEM. Second credential domain: the resident holds its own copy; rotate both together (GitHub → generate new key → put on both → revoke old).
